title: BentoBox Blueprint Bundle Format
description:
Schema describing the on-disk JSON format of a BentoBox blueprint bundle file.

A bundle groups up to three `.blueprint` files — one per world environment (overworld / nether / end) — into a single option that appears in the island-creation UI. It also controls the cost, permission, GUI slot, usage cap, and post-creation commands for that option.

FILE FORMAT:
  - Plain UTF-8 JSON.
  - One bundle per file. Filename MUST be `<uniqueId>.json` (the stem matches the `uniqueId` field).
  - Location: the `blueprints/` folder of a game-mode addon (e.g. `plugins/BentoBox/addons/BSkyBlock/blueprints/default.json`). The referenced blueprints live alongside as `<name>.blueprint` files and are validated by the sibling `blueprint.schema.json`.

SERIALIZATION NOTES (Gson-based):
  - Only fields explicitly tagged `@Expose` in the Java source are emitted; producers must not emit other keys.
  - The `blueprints` map is keyed by the Java `World.Environment` enum and is written as a normal JSON object with the enum NAME (e.g. `NORMAL`) as the key.
  - Pretty-printing is enabled by the writer; consumers must not rely on whitespace.

uniqueId.description: Unique identifier for this bundle. Must equal the filename stem (e.g. `default` for `default.json`). Used as the permission suffix when `requirePermission` is true: `<gamemode>.island.create.<uniqueId>`.

displayName.description: Human-readable name shown in the selection GUI. May contain legacy `§` colour codes or MiniMessage tags per locale conventions.

icon.description: Icon material. One of: a plain Bukkit Material enum name (e.g. `DIAMOND`), a vanilla namespaced key (e.g. `minecraft:diamond`), or a resource-pack custom model key (e.g. `myserver:island_tropical`). Default: `PAPER`.

description.description: Lore lines shown under the icon. One string per line.

blueprints.description: Map from world environment to the `name` of a Blueprint in the same folder. Environments with no entry are not generated for this bundle; keys correspond to Bukkit `World.Environment` enum names.

additionalProperties.description: The `name` field of a sibling Blueprint (i.e. the file's stem without the `.blueprint` extension).

requirePermission.description: If true, a player must hold `<gamemode>.island.create.<uniqueId>` to use this bundle.

slot.description: Preferred slot (0-based) in the selection GUI. Runtime clamps to the visible inventory size.

times.description: Maximum number of islands a single player may create with this bundle. `0` means unlimited.

cost.description: Vault-economy cost to use this bundle. `0` means free. Requires a Vault-compatible economy plugin at runtime.

commands.description: Commands executed when an island is created with this bundle. Placeholders `[player]` and `[owner]` are substituted. Entries prefixed with `[SUDO]` run as the creating player; others run as console. (Added in BentoBox 2.6.0.)
